measuredGaps.detail: The positional consumer.retail-brand:v1 argument starts the default SaaS artifact. Use an explicit --world-path and check WORLDFIXTURE_WORLD_ID.
Bundled retail Calendar projection returns HTTP 500 on calendarList. Rebuilding authored JSON with the corrected image fixes its calendar fields.

measuredGaps.detail: The current history route ignores oldest/latest/inclusive. The app sends the official timestamp bounds and follows bounded cursor pages until the exact returned message timestamp and text are found. It does not resend the write.
IMAP BigInt metadata is converted to exact decimal strings before JSON storage or API output. No integer precision is lost.
